name: calendar-history-toast
title: Undo toast
description: An Undo toast for a calendar's event history, built on Base UI's Toast: after each change it offers to undo it, and after an undo, to redo it. It adds Mod+Z and Shift+Mod+Z or Ctrl+Y in the calendar's frame, speaks undo and redo through the Announcer, and speaks a change no gesture announced with how to reach Undo. English messages to edit or translate.
